problem_statement: Build a brand-new /partners page from scratch on the AstroWind (Astro 5 + Tailwind) marketing site. The route /partners does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Construct a full 'Technology Partners' directory page that reuses the site's shared PageLayout chrome (Header nav + Footer) and theme tokens so it is visually consistent with sibling pages (about/services/pricing). The page shows a hero, an intro section, a client-side category filter (Cloud / Security / Data) implemented as buttons, and a responsive grid of partner cards that swaps according to the selected category. Must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px).
required_content: Reuse the shared PageLayout (Header nav + Footer) so nav/footer match every sibling page (cross-page consistency)
HeroText hero with the page title 'Partners'
Intro section: h2 'Our partner ecosystem' + a lede paragraph
Category filter: three buttons labelled Cloud, Security, Data (unique data-cat attribute)
Default-active Cloud panel listing partner cards (Nimbus Cloud, Skyforge Compute, Orbit Storage) with h3 name + description each
Client-side interaction: clicking Security reveals the Security partners (SentinelGuard, Aegis Identity) and hides the others
Inline static partner data (no network fetch)
Responsive: partner grid collapses to single column on mobile with zero horizontal overflow
Intro lede paragraph text: 'Every partner below is vetted for accessibility and performance. Filter by category to find the right fit for your stack.'

Cloud partner card descriptions: Nimbus Cloud -> 'Managed cloud hosting with global edge regions and one-click AstroWind deploys.'; Skyforge Compute -> 'Elastic container platform tuned for static-first Astro workloads.'; Orbit Storage -> 'Durable object storage with an image CDN for your media assets.'

Security partner cards (revealed on Security click): SentinelGuard -> 'Runtime application firewall and DDoS shielding for production sites.'; Aegis Identity -> 'Drop-in SSO and passwordless auth for gated content areas.'
Footer nav must include cross-page consistency links 'Careers' and 'Docs' (inherited from shared PageLayout), matching sibling pages
design_constraints: Use the site's Tailwind v4 theme tokens (text-primary/bg-primary/text-muted/text-heading, .btn utility)

Palette (match the site theme tokens): page background white rgb(255,255,255); body/heading text near-black rgb(16,16,16); primary accent / active-filter button rgb(1,97,239) (#0161EF), with a darker hover rgb(1,84,207); muted body copy rgba(16,16,16,0.66)
Typography: hero h1 'Partners' large and bold (font-heading, ~text-5xl / md:text-6xl); section h2 'Our partner ecosystem' ~text-3xl / md:text-4xl; card names as h3

Layout structure: HeroText hero at top, then an intro section (h2 + lede), then the three-button category filter row (Cloud active by default), then a responsive multi-column card grid that collapses to a single column at 390px
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /partners(仅空 <html><body></body>,无 layout); reference 完整实现 + 工作 filter; bad 与 reference 逐字节相同,只把 filter 脚本选择器从 button[data-cat] 改成 button[data-tab] → 监听器不挂载,点击分类无反应 → 只失 interaction gate,其余全过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。#18ae: 三份都删掉 astro.config 的 sitemap()。跨页一致性(#18ag)编码为 footer <a> 'Careers'/'Docs' dom_assertions,同时绑 desktop_partners 与 sibling desktop_services 两个 state。
